decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a distant, uncertain niche with long naval procurement cycles, so the option has not yet resolved, and keeping a single website mention on the market costs little, so the option is still worth holding.

The medical examination light builds on established lighting competence and has its own product page, so its prospects are still open and carrying it is cheap relative to its potential in institutional healthcare markets.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires extend the firm's core certified industrial offer as a full product line, and their value looks likely to be realized, so further commitment is justified.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the core offer, so demand uncertainty is low and the cost of keeping it is minimal.
